title: Remove the central audit log copy from the legal text
body:
Child of catenahq/ops#474 (umbrella, parent-task). The SPEC.md row (catena-ce) and the features.yml entry (ops) named there are already gone from main; only this repository's part remains. The central audit copy is also the open item of the legal-text rewrite to the three editions (d1c2bd0 and f105bc9 rewrote the master agreement, the SLA and the data-export schedule; MSA 3.1 has no minimum term).

The central Grafana, Loki and the Alloy audit shipper left catena-admin. These texts still describe the central audit log copy as a service: `legal/subprocessors.md:20,31` (line 65 is the 1.1 version row and stays), `legal/master-agreement.md:102,138`, `legal/data-export-and-termination.md:22,71`. `legal/subprocessors.md` gets a new version row.

A change needs a new legal version and its pin in `legal/msa.json`. Regenerating catena-admin's `subprocessors.json` (`go run ./shell/panels/compliance/cmd/contracts-gen --legal ../contracts/legal --out shell/panels/compliance/data`) is a separate change in catena-admin.

The owner reviews the pull request before merge (hold-for-review).

title: The legal text describes a pricing model that is not the decided one
body:
`legal/master-agreement.md` defines App Subscriptions (one per managed application beyond Nextcloud + OnlyOffice), an
Installer Fee (Base or Assisted), a Support Pack and a six-month minimum; `sla.md` has "Installer Fee only" rows. The
decided editions are Community, Pro (one flat price per server) and Business; the MSA definitions and section 2 have the
Operator provisioning and operating the Suite, which the client installs.

- **Behaviour:** the MSA and its schedules describe one pricing model: the three editions.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** the owner's wording, with the `legal/msa.json` bump.

Part of catenahq/ops#282 (Docs and spec issues: Legal text describes a pricing model that is not the decided one), which tracks the change across repositories.

### Files Scope

- `legal/master-agreement.md`
- `legal/sla.md`
- `legal/data-export-and-termination.md`
- `legal/msa.json`
